title: Event envelope
description: Fields shared by every event published to NATS. Each event type references this schema and narrows `type`, `version` and `data`.

id.description: Unique event id. Publishers also send it as the Nats-Msg-Id header so JetStream can drop duplicates.

type.description: Event type. It is always the NATS subject the event is published on.

version.description: Version of the `data` schema for this event type.

occurredAt.description: When the event happened, in RFC 3339 format.

correlationId.description: Id of the request or process that caused the event. Used to follow a flow across services in the logs.
